graders.name: concise
graders.criteria: Judge AGENTS.md. Compared with the original three rules (pnpm; `pnpm test` before a pull request; pull requests against `develop`), it adds one short rule saying test fixtures live under `src/testing/`. It adds no examples, no pointer to the README, no other new rules, and does not reword the existing ones. A brief clause that tests should use those fixtures is acceptable.

graders.name: keeps-existing
graders.pattern: - Use pnpm, never npm or yarn\.[\s\S]*- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request\.[\s\S]*- Open pull requests against `develop`\.
graders.description: Existing rules are unchanged and keep their order; the new rule may go anywhere in the list.
